rules.instruction: Actual failures: no bright empty orange wall, generic photo background or boring portrait. The orange glass architecture must be original, physically integrated and visible behind subjects, with cinematic story and believable shadows.
Actual failures: reject pseudo-URLs, watermark-like lettering, embroidery/garment characters and writing on props or walls. Do not publish; model output requires pixel QA.
Actual failures: any false brand icon, mark on wristwatch, jacket or architecture is a hard rejection. Only SHA-verified Mr Bogart official Fénix logo in deterministic postproduction.
Actual failures: no glowing approval tick, seals or symbolic loan acceptance. Before-deposit educational imagery must never imply that a legal or mortgage transaction has been approved.
Actual failures: fused extra fingers, melted hands, odd arm poses. Keep hands naturally positioned with realistic five-finger geometry and avoid dominant artificial hand gestures.

Actual failures: no one-person-dominates-while-other-tiny, cut-off subjects or all people staring blankly. Compose intentional two-person portrait in believable local environment, eye-level medium shot, faces clear.

Actual failures: orange slab backgrounds and flat studio-like illumination are insufficient. Require nuanced key/fill, true Mediterranean directional sunlight, readable shadows and premium controlled cinematic color.

next_gate: Design stronger safe cinematic source without approval-like icons, build brand postprocessor and comprehensive visual QA before enabling automatic publication or next video phase.
